title: ID0431563-DC/Si-D/FR- [Y2 / P9 312561850/13] Terminal not working
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
The terminal on this charger is no longer working. The
logs displays the following error: mqtt:
pt/changelanguage/response
{"status":"timeout","message":"terminal communication timeout"}
I also haven’t seen any transactions for quite some time.
I have attached photos showing the error on the logs
Workaround: Restart CCV container
Solution: FW Update to v10.X
